story: After an early attempt by Red Bull Bora Hansgrohe to split the peloton, a group of 12 riders escaped but was caught 80km from the finish. Several failed attacks followed, with Laurence Pithie and Riley Sheehan gaining seconds in intermediate sprints. A mass sprint was inevitable, but a major crash in the final corner allowed Ben Oliver to claim stage victory and the overall lead.
